situation: A gardener in a shed has accidentally cut his finger while pruning shears slipped.
subject: the red liquid
brief: A middle-aged man sits on a low wooden stool in a sunlit potting shed, looking down at his thumb where a single, perfectly formed droplet of bright crimson liquid wells up against the pale skin. A pair of garden shears rests discarded on the worktable beside clay pots, and a shaft of morning light catches the dark red bead in sharp relief.
